text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Seeking the Pearl barges<n>into my office with gusto.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Get ready to pack your bags! It's<n>time for us to take on international<n>races!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's simple! Countless tough<n>opponents are waiting for me on the<n>other side of the sea!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's start by going to France!<n>Bonjour, Calvados!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pearl's been wanting to compete<n>overseas for a while now. Given her<n>skills, it wouldn't be impossible...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But first we'd need to apply for leave<n>from Tracen, get approval from the<n>URA, register as a racer at our<n>destination, secure lodgings while<n>we're there, and the list goes on...
choice_data_list:
You probably won't be able to run in races for a
while, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I've already considered that! ♪ While<n>we're waiting, we can take in the<n>beautiful gardens and air that France<n>has to offer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: As long as I keep up my training over<n>there, it's all okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like she's been thinking abouthow to make good use of her timewhile overseas. Still, it's not like wecan just pack our bags and go. Goodthing I prepared that...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The VR Umalator! So this is what you<n>meant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The VR Umalator is a simulator for<n>races. It can replicate various<n>racecourses under different weather<n>conditions.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I see, I can simulate racing against<n>international powerhouses around the<n>world! Very good!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hurry, let us start up the simulator! I'll<n>show you my possibilities in virtual<n>space!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I configure the settings and boot up<n>the program. I choose a French<n>racecourse along with a handful of<n>international powerhouses.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The turf is so springy... Haha, a<n>perfect fit for my feet! Time to show<n>off my top speed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This long straightaway leads straight<n>to glory! Umamusume from around<n>the world! Just try and keep up with<n>yours truly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl leaves the other<n>powerhouses in the dust and crosses<n>the finish line in first!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I disagree! How can you call that<n>perfect? Next time, let me run<n>alongside bison and deer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In the past, wild animals have<n>charged onto the track during races<n>overseas! It's entirely possible that<n>might happen in one of my races too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Unpredictable happenings,<n>unexpected troubles—you can only<n>claim you're prepared once you've<n>overcome them all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to try running in<n>every situation I can imagine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The overseas races Pearl describes<n>are an unknown domain even to me. I<n>doubt any amount of preparation<n>would fully satisfy her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But as her trainer, it's my job to<n>meet her needs! For now, I'll have<n>her experience a bunch of different<n>situations.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, now that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Set the temperature to 40 degrees<n>Celsius! And make the turf dried-up!<n>Oh, and prepare the opposite situation<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Can you also make the conditions of<n>the simulated Umamusume random?
choice_data_list:
Sure thing, just give me some time to input the
data!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Excellent! I'll leave it to you then!<n>Next, I'll get ready to run in America!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wanting to match Pearl's enthusiasm<n>for training, I devote myself to the<n>computer. When I look up, the sun is<n>already up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But, Pearl is waiting for me in the<n>gym. I... need... to go...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hm, is Trainer running late? ...Oh, the<n>data input is done!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, well they've been hard at<n>work. More importantly, it's time to<n>run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the all-nighter I pulled, Pearl<n>is now able to experience a plethora<n>of possibilities within the virtual<n>simulator.
